pins.definition: The ceremony and celebration where two people get married.
The ceremony and celebration in which two people get married.

situation: Two people stand side by side under a floral arch facing a small gathering of seated guests.
subject: the marriage ceremony
brief: A bride and groom stand facing each other holding hands beneath an archway decorated with white flowers, while a small group of guests looks on from wooden chairs. Streamers and confetti hang mid-air in the bright light, capturing the joyous celebration of the ceremony.
